{{Quote|Morning, Senators. You should all consider yourselves to be in my power. As long as everybody behaves, this will be quick and painless. Do nothing, and it will all be over soon.|Cad Bane|audio=MorningSenators.flac|<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />}}
The '''Senate hostage crisis''' occurred in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] when the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]] hired the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to organize a raid on the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] aimed at capturing [[Senator/Legends|members]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Bane sought to force [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to issue a pardon for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]], who had previously been [[Raid on Ziro the Hutt's Coruscant club|arrested]] and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] in the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] for his role in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' kidnapping of his great-nephew, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]]. Bane formed a team of [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters that included the [[Jedi hunter/Legends|Jedi hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama]], and the [[Patrolian/Legends|Patrolian]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]], along with several Confederate [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. After testing his team by pitting them against fellow bounty hunter [[Davtokk]], Bane deemed his accomplices ready for their mission.

Infiltrating the Executive Building and [[Death/Legends|disposing]] of multiple [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commando]] guards along the way, the team took a small group of senators hostage. Bane trapped Palpatine and Senator [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] in [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|the Chancellor's office]] by having Robonino shut down the building's power. Bane then issued an ultimatum to the Supreme Chancellor: Ziro was to be released, or the senators would be executed. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was still in the building, though unarmed, and was knocked out and captured by the hunters. To secure the Hutt's release in exchange for the senators' lives, Bane ordered Taa to take a [[Pardon disc/Legends|pardon disc]] to the Detention Center to release Ziro.

Taa reluctantly complied and was escorted to the prison by the [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|sentinel droid]] [[HELIOS-3D/Legends|HELIOS-3D]]. As final leverage against Palpatine, the bounty hunters set up a system of [[Laser/Legends|lasers]] around the senators that would trigger explosives with the slightest touch before leaving the building. [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] led by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Fox/Legends|CC-1010]] arrived to apprehend Bane's team on the landing platform, but the still-trapped senators allowed the bounty hunters to escape with Ziro. Although Bane remotely activated the explosives as payback for the indignities the Hutt had suffered in prison, a revived Skywalker was able to cut a hole around the senators, and all of them dropped into the room below seconds before the explosives went off.

==Prelude==
===The hiring of a bounty hunter===
{{Quote|Let's let the scavengers clean this up. Our business is on Coruscant.|Cad Bane, after killing Davtokk|<ref name="Invitation Only">''[[The Clone Wars: Invitation Only]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Ziro_captured.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ziro is arrested by Amidala and the Coruscant Guard.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and the uncle to fellow crime lord [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], participated in a plot orchestrated by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], to kidnap Jabba's son, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], and frame the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for the crime. However, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] discovered the plot and had Ziro [[Raid on Ziro the Hutt's Coruscant club|arrested]] in [[Ziro's Palace/Legends|his palace]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Fox/Legends|CC-1010]], nicknamed "Fox," and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]].<ref name="TCWn">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref><ref name="TCWf">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> Ziro was subsequently incarcerated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] on Coruscant,<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> a heavily guarded [[Prison/Legends|prison]].<ref name="C-3PO and R2-D2 Adventure">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/evil_plans_preview/index.html|text=C-3PO and R2-D2 Get An Adventure of Their Own}}</ref> Though initially happy to let Ziro rot in prison, the Hutt clans later reconsidered<ref name="Visual Guide Updated">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]''</ref> in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Hostage Crisis Date" /> when it was discovered that Ziro had hidden a [[Hutt Council records/Legends|holodiary record]] of all criminal dealings of the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]]<ref name="Hunt for Ziro">{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}}</ref> dating back generations.<ref name="Visual Guide Updated" /> To that end, Jabba the Hutt and his colleagues on the Grand Council decided that it would be better for Ziro to be transferred into their custody.<ref name="Evil Plans" />

Jabba initially hired the renowned [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to gain access to the plans to the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]]. Following Bane's success with that assignment, Jabba gained the Hutt Council's approval to contract the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter to free Ziro. Instead of a straightforward prison break, Bane was to use the plans of the Republic Executive Building<ref name="Evil Plans" /> to organize a raid on the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. With members of the Senate taken hostage, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] would be forced to issue a pardon for Ziro.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> Furthermore, the Hutts&mdash;remembering [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku's manipulations of them surrounding the kidnapping of Rotta&mdash;schemed to frame the Separatists for breaking Ziro out of prison. Bane assembled a team of bounty hunters and infiltration specialists<ref name="Visual Guide Updated" /> consisting of the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama]]<ref name="Hostage Crisis Ep Guide" /> and the [[Patrolian/Legends|Patrolian]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]],<ref name="Art of SW:TCW" /> backed up by several Confederate [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] and [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droids]].<ref name="Hostage Crisis Ep Guide" /> He even broke the [[Jedi hunter/Legends|Jedi hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] out of prison<ref name="Filoni Facebook Q&A">{{Facebook|username=DaveFiloni|url=notes/dave-filoni/qa/10150219391017571|name=[[Dave Filoni]]|date=2011-03-23|archivedate=20160101103626|archivefile=File:DaveFiloniQA-Facebook.png}}</ref> so that she could add her [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] abilities to the team.<ref name="Visual Guide Updated" /> As the organic members of the group usually operated alone, Bane organized a test for them.<ref name="Invitation Only" /> Knowing that rival<ref name="DB Cad Bane">{{DB|character|cadbane|Bane, Cad}}</ref> bounty hunter [[Davtokk]] intended to kill him for the bounty on his head, Bane lured Davtokk to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Keyorin]] under the pretense that he was seeking recruits. There, Robonino, Alama, and Sing succeeded in crippling Davtokk, earning Bane's trust that they would be able to function together as a team. After [[Death/Legends|disposing]] of Davtokk,<ref name="Invitation Only" /> Bane took his team to Coruscant to free Ziro.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

===A secret meeting===
{{Quote|I have to bring this bill before the Senate. It's important.''"<br />"''Uh-huh. More important than the way you feel about me?|Senator Padmé Amidala is teased by Anakin Skywalker|audio=AnakinPadmeItsImportant-HostageCrisis.flac|<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />}}
[[File:PadmeAmidalasOffice-HostageCrisis.png|thumb|right|250px|Skywalker visits Senator Amidala in her office.]]
While he was supposed to be on a meditative retreat, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] visited his secret [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], Senator Padmé Amidala, in [[Padmé's office/Legends|her office]] in the Republic Executive Building on Coruscant. During their discussion, Skywalker asserted that there was nothing more important to him than his love for her, and he gave Amidala [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|his lightsaber]] to symbolize his faith in her. However, Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], followed by C-3PO, then entered the room, seeking Amidala's presence for a meeting organized by Senator [[Philo/Legends|Philo]] to discuss the [[Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill/Legends|Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill]], a piece of Senate legislation. Skywalker hid behind Amidala's desk, and Amidala, hiding Skywalker's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in her sleeves, followed Organa to the meeting and took the lightsaber with her, unable to return it to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

==The operation==
===Entering and taking hostages===
{{Quote|Put up your hands.''"<br />"''I got business with the Senate. How about you fellows step aside?|Captain Jayfon and Cad Bane|audio=CadBaneBusinessWithTheSenate.flac|<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />}}
Arriving on Coruscant, Bane's team split up to gain entrance to the Executive Building. Bane, Alama, a sentinel droid,<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> and two [[Droid/Legends|droid]] commandos for assistance in protecting Bane<ref name="Stand Aside">''[[The Clone Wars: Stand Aside - Bounty Hunters!]]''</ref> arrived at the building in an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]], where they were confronted by a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commando]] guards. From an adjacent tower, Sing distracted the guards with covering sniper [[Laser/Legends|fire]], taking out most of the Commandos by herself, while Alama and the droids also engaged the Senate Guards.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> Bane eliminated the guards' [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Jayfon/Legends|Jayfon]],<ref name="Art of SW:TCW" /> and the commando droids dressed up in the Senate Guards' [[Armor/Legends|armor]] to ensure that the brawl would go undiscovered. Sing, Robonino, and the sentinel droids<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> [[HELIOS-3D/Legends|HELIOS-3D]]<ref name="DB Cad Bane" /> and [[HELIOS-3E/Legends|HELIOS-3E]]<ref name="Evil Plans Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode308.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Evil Plans}}</ref> arrived at the scene in a second airspeeder. Leaving both BX units outside to clear the platform of the dead Senate Commandos, the team of bounty hunters made their way into the complex. HELIOS-3D also remained behind with the airspeeder.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

[[File:CadBanesPosse-HostageCrisis.png|thumb|left|250px|Cad Bane and his team outside the Republic Executive Building]]
Disposing of a guard stationed at the Executive Building's [[Power control room/Legends|power control room]], the group also destroyed an [[LEP servant droid/Legends|assistant droid]], the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]]<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> [[D-0T]],<ref name="CWA Shop: D-0T">{{TCWA|set=D-0T}}</ref> a [[WED-15 Treadwell droid/Legends|WED-15 Treadwell]],<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R5-S9/Legends|R5-S9]]<ref name="UK Comic 6.23">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.23|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.23]]</ref> in the room. Leaving Robonino to sabotage the building's power distribution network, the rest of the team headed to the meeting of senators. On the way to the [[Senate East Wing/Legends|East Wing]] of the building where the senators had gathered,<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> Bane&mdash;having planning his operation during Senate Guard shifts&mdash;eliminated most of the active Senate security<ref name="DB Cad Bane" /> by tossing a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] into the Senate Commandos' barracks when two shifts were assembled there. Sing eliminated the only survivor with a shot to the head. The group then entered the Annex Dome, surrounding and taking [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] Senators Organa, Amidala, Philo, [[Dantum Roohd/Legends|Dantum Roohd]], [[Zinn Paulness/Legends|Zinn Paulness]], [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]], [[Jakker-Sun/Legends|Jakker-Sun]],<ref name="Hostage Crisis Ep Guide" /><ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> [[Kin Robb/Legends|Kin Robb]],<ref name="Voyage of Temptation">{{TCW|Voyage of Temptation}}</ref> and a [[Unidentified Christophsian senator/Legends|Christophsian senator]], as well as C-3PO. After Philo objected to being taken hostage, attempting to leave while refusing to "listen to insolence," Bane shot him in the back and ordered the rest of the senators to hand over any communication devices in their possession.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

Bane made contact with Palpatine in [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|his office]] and demanded the release of Ziro from the Detention Center. After Palpatine objected, Robonino shut down the building's power, activating its emergency lockdown and leaving Palpatine and Senator [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] trapped in the office with external communications disabled. However, Bane was unaware that Skywalker was still inside the building. Noticing that the building's red backup lights had activated, Skywalker left Amidala's office to find out what was happening. Upon arriving above the atrium where the senators were being held, the Jedi noticed the bounty hunters surrounding their hostages and spied on the events taking place.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

===Securing the Hutt and escape===
{{Quote|You were foolish to think you could get away with this, bounty hunter. Now lay down your arms and come quietly.''"<br />"''No, Chancellor, I'm afraid it is you who has been foolish&hellip;with your senators' lives. One false move and the east wing of the Senate Building goes up in smoke.|Supreme Chancellor Palpatine and Cad Bane|audio=SenateHostageCrisisPartingGift.flac|<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />}}
When Bane spotted Skywalker above the lobby, he fired at him before sending Alama and a [[Unidentified IG-86 sentinel droid (Cad Bane)/Legends|sentinel droid]] after the fleeing Jedi. Contacting Palpatine&mdash;who had been trapped in his office with Senator Taa for two hours<ref name="Hostage Crisis Decoded" />&mdash;by plugging his [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] into a communications outpost, Skywalker learned that it was up to him to turn the power back on so that reinforcements could be summoned. As Alama and the droid approached the room where Skywalker was speaking with Palpatine, the Jedi quickly unplugged his comlink and hid right before the two hunters entered the room. Skywalker used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on Alama to get the two off his trail, and Alama and the droid separated. Sneaking up on the sentinel droid, Skywalker attacked but was forced to engage it in close combat without a lightsaber. Alama returned to find the destroyed droid, but by examining its remains, Alama deduced that the Jedi was unarmed.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

After reporting this new information to Bane, Alama continued the hunt with the added aid of Sing. Outside the power control room, Skywalker stumbled across Robonino, and the technician quickly retreated back into the room. As Skywalker attempted to break into the room, Alama found him, and the Jedi [[Telekinesis/Legends|pulled]] Alama's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] out of his hand with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. However, Sing took aim at Skywalker from behind the Weequay, and as Alama ducked, Sing shot the blaster out of Skywalker's hand. With Skywalker backed against the door of the power control room, Robonino joined the fray and [[Stun/Legends|shocked]] the Jedi. The unconscious Skywalker was brought to Bane in [[Binders/Legends|handcuffs]], and Bane instructed Palpatine to make a [[Pardon disc/Legends|pardon disc]] and to give it to Senator Taa, who would deliver the disc to the prison so that Ziro could be released.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> HELIOS-3D escorted Taa to the landing platform, where a speeder was parked with a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] attached for the large Hutt. Upon arrival at the Detention Center, Taa released Ziro, whom 3D took back to the Executive Building, while Taa remained in the safety of the Coruscant Guard at the prison.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

[[File:Laser_trigger.png|thumb|right|250px|Skywalker and the senators are left trapped within a laser-triggered bomb trap.]]
In the atrium, Bane's team set up their "parting gifts" around the senators: a system of lasers that would trigger explosives upon the slightest touch. The bounty hunters sought to use the hostages as final leverage if Palpatine attempted to apprehend them while they were still on Coruscant. Wishing the senators and Jedi a "most respectful farewell," Bane left the building with his team. On Taa's orders, the Coruscant Guard broke through the [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] [[Window/Legends|window]] of Palpatine's office and ensured that the Chancellor was safe. Outside on a landing platform, a pair of [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] arrived, and Coruscant Guard [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Fox<ref name="Hostage Crisis Decoded" /> piled out and cornered the bounty hunters.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

Palpatine contacted Bane and ordered him to surrender, but the bounty hunter revealed the still-trapped senators, and in order to keep them safe, Palpatine reluctantly relinquished his attempts to apprehend Bane. Commander Fox ordered his [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] forces to stand down, allowing Bane and his team to leave. Back in the East Wing, Skywalker awoke, and Amidala cut Skywalker's binders off with his lightsaber. Once he and his team were a safe distance away from the Executive Building, Bane remotely activated the explosives as payback for the indignities Ziro had suffered in prison. However, Skywalker was able to cut a hole in the floor around the senators, allowing all of them to drop into the room below seconds before the explosives went off.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Oh, I have no illusions about the fact that my escape was a result of the highly sensitive knowledge that I possess. A holodiary cataloging the nefarious deeds of this council. [&hellip;] Kill me and the diary will show up on the step of the Senate. The cold, hard reality is that as long as I control this highly sensitive material, my memory will only get ''duller''.|Ziro Desilijic Tiure, to the Hutt Grand Council|<ref name="Hunt for Ziro" />}}
[[File:Hutt_Council.png|thumb|left|250px|Ziro is brought before his liberators, the leaders of the Hutt Council.]]
Following their escape, Bane transferred the reward to his comrades' accounts and ordered them to flee separately, escaping from the eyes of the Republic. However, Alama was [[Battle of Florrum|ambushed]] by a Confederate [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class frigate]] and a Republic LAAT/i gunship over the planet [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]].<ref name="Hunting the Hunters I" /> Similarly, Robonino was [[Skirmish on Rodia|attacked]] at [[Robonino's hideout|his underwater headquarters]] on the planet [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] by Republic forces,<ref name="Hunting the Hunters II">[[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part II)|''The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters'' (Part II)]]</ref> and HELIOS-3D's [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] encampment in the [[Thicket]] of the planet [[Iego/Legends|Iego]] was [[Mission to the Thicket|destroyed]] by the Jedi Anakin Skywalker and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="Hunting the Hunters III">[[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part III)|''The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters'' (Part III)]]</ref> Meanwhile, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] pursued Bane and Ziro the Hutt across Coruscant's [[Skylane/Legends|skylanes]] as they escaped in an airspeeder, but Vos was unable to stop Bane<ref name="CWA: Crisis Ziro">{{TCWA|Crisis Ziro}}</ref> from delivering Ziro to the Hutt Council's [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace/Legends|headquarters]] on the planet [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. After Ziro abstained from revealing the location of his holodiary record, he managed to escape from the Hutts' custody with the [[Music/Legends|singer]] [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]], who, unbeknownst to Ziro, had secretly been hired by Jabba to retrieve the holodiary. Ziro's pursuers soon grew to include Bane, whom the Hutt Council contracted to track down the fugitive crime lord, and Master Kenobi and Vos, whom the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] had dispatched to apprehend Ziro and Bane, the latter for his hostage takeover of the Senate. Bane's and the Jedi's manhunt for Ziro culminated in a [[Showdown on Teth/Legends|confrontation]] on the planet [[Teth/Legends|Teth]].<ref name="Hunt for Ziro" />

On a [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] [[HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided (Part 1)|broadcast]] that followed Bane's raid on the Senate, the young [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Salo]] swore vengeance on Bane for murdering Senator Philo&mdash;whom Salo had greatly admired&mdash;during the raid.<ref name="Republic Heroes HoloNet News 2">[[HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided (Part 1)|''HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided'' (Part 1)]]</ref> Nevertheless, the audacity of Bane's raid on the Senate ensured that he would have plenty of clients in the future.<ref name="Visual Guide Updated" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You get to see that short of coming up against a Jedi, these bounty hunters are incredibly dangerous, so dangerous that they take over the entire Senate. That's a very difficult thing to do. This group does it. Quite effectively, quite violently.|Series Director [[Dave Filoni]]|<ref name="Complete Season One">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One]]</ref>}}
The Senate hostage crisis<ref name="UK Comic 6.1">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.1|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.1]]</ref> was featured in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[2009]] [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] finale, "[[Hostage Crisis]]."<ref name="Hostage Crisis Ep Guide" /> The [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|webcomic]] [[The Clone Wars: Invitation Only|''Invitation Only'']] led into "Hostage Crisis" and depicted Bane's test of his team against Davtokk. The raid notably featured the debut of bounty hunters in the series,<ref name="Hostage Crisis Ep Guide" /> as well as one of the first appearances of Cad Bane,<ref name="Deadly New Enemy">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20090317.html|text=The Chilling Season Finale Introduces a Deadly New Enemy}}</ref> a bounty hunter featured more throughout the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]].<ref name="Season Two Preview">{{SW|url=video/the-clone-wars-season-two-preview|text=The Clone Wars Season Two Preview}}</ref> The event was officially named in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.1|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic UK 6.1]]'' magazine.<ref name="UK Comic 6.1" />

[[File:BaneHutts.png|thumb|right|250px|The Hutt Grand Council was not identified as Bane's employer for quite some time.]]
The party that employed Bane for his raid on the Senate was not clarified for quite some time, as "Hostage Crisis" did not identify the party.<ref name="OEG:S1">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''</ref> Although some first season publicity materials stated that Bane had been hired by the leaders of the Separatists&mdash;[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious<ref name="DB Cad Bane" /> and Count Dooku<ref name="Deadly New Enemy" />&mdash;Bane's clients were revised to be the Hutts with the publication of the bounty hunter's [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry in 2009.<ref name="DB Cad Bane" /> Despite this change, the later-published ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]'' further complicated the matter by claiming that Bane's employer had yet to be identified in the television series' second season.<ref name="OEG:S1" /> The issue was finally resolved in the [[2010]] [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] episode "[[Evil Plans]]," which served as a prequel to "Hostage Crisis" and solidified the Databank's claim that Bane had been hired by the Hutts.<ref name="Evil Plans Ep Guide" /> The third season episode "[[Hunt for Ziro]]" served as a sequel to "Hostage Crisis" and depicted the aftermath of the hostage crisis,<ref name="Hunt for Ziro Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode309.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Hunt for Ziro}}</ref> as did StarWars.com's trio of ''Hunting the Hunters'' [[Star Wars comic books|webcomics]], which transitioned between the television series' first and second seasons.<ref name="Hunting the Hunters I" /><ref name="Hunting the Hunters II" /><ref name="Hunting the Hunters III" /> Furthermore, an [[in-universe]] explanation for the employer inconsistency came in [[2012]] with the publication ''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]'', which stated that the Hutts had framed the Separatists for the hostage crisis in retribution for Count Dooku's earlier kidnapping of Rotta the Huttlet.<ref name="Visual Guide Updated" />

Although the raid took place entirely in the Republic Executive Building, several of the episode's dialogue sequences indicated otherwise, implying that the senators were being held in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. To further complicate matters, the smoke from Bane's explosives was seen coming from the Senate Building instead of the Executive Building, an animation error that the series' crew noticed but did not fix in time.<ref name="Insider 110">{{InsiderCite|110|Ask Lobot}}</ref>

The 2011 non-canonical ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' video game depicted the Senate hostage crisis in its adaptation of "Hostage Crisis." In addition to presenting more humorous and comical depictions of the hostage crisis, the game also modified the event's storyline. In the game, Ziro the Hutt directly hires Bane to free him from prison, without the involvement of the Hutt Council. The level featuring the hostage crisis ends after the Republic Executive Building's power generator is shut down.<ref name="LEGO Star Wras III">''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>
